messages.author: JoshMD
messages.text: The 12 hour population growth freeze from losing a battle is still active on my nation despite the war ending over 12 hours ago

messages.author: Kurai
messages.text: It's not just you, dede froze it for the entire game until he finishes working on the new growth mechanics

messages.author: JoshMD
messages.text: Oh, I thought those were already out. But regardless it looks like it is working now so he might just be to quick

messages.text: <@465912833352138768> yep, staff confirmed the growth freeze is paused game-wide while the new growth mechanics are being worked on, and you said it's working again, so nothing to fix here

title: 12 Hour Population Growth Freeze Isn't Ending
